statements.t: We believe that excluding certain items from our GAAP results allows management to better understand our consolidated financial performance and, in the case of Adjusted Free Cash Flow, our liquidity, from period to period and better project our future consolidated financial performance as forecasts are developed at a level of detail different from that used to prepare GAAP-based financial measures.

I believe this quarter and year as a whole will serve as proof points of the durability of our business, our ability to allocate capital for diversified growth, and the power of our products; that are category leaders across multiple attractive verticals and continue to win.
Durability: During the quarter we largely achieved our guidance despite what I would categorize as a more challenging backdrop than we’ve seen in recent years.
Our international expansion remains on track but can also improve from here.

We are live in 15 countries with Shift4 One ahead of schedule and expect to be exiting the year with nearly $50M in synergies from Global Blue, which puts us well on our way to our previously stated 2027 synergy target of $70M.

We are revising our full year 2026 Volume guidance to $240 to $250 billion, tightening the upper end of the range, lowering our full-year 2026 Gross Revenue less Network Fees guidance to $2.45 to $2.46 billion, and adjusting full-year Adjusted EBITDA to $1.11 to $1.13 billion.
For those keeping score, this guidance is roughly 4% lower on Gross Revenues Less Network Fees and 6% lower on Adjusted EBITDA than our original full year 2026 guidance.
